added.summary: A model that says `conform effect` (an effect's mesh, in its import settings or `type model` text) is held to no face budget: the cook neither simplifies it nor warns of it, and og style check skips its faces. og vfx import writes it beside every mesh it makes, and an Effekseer project in assets/ gives its meshes the same.

A vfx `mesh ring` element takes its own shape: `inner <radius>`, `band <0..1>`, `height <outer> <inner>` (a cone, a tube), `arc <start> <length>`, `segments <n>` and `colors <outer rgba> <band rgba> <inner rgba>`, built at load with u along its arc and v across it. A plain `mesh ring` draws as before. og vfx import writes Effekseer rings this way instead of a .glb per ring node.

`subEmitter life "<emitter id>" [<inherit velocity>]`: each particle runs the other emitter's own emission (its rate, bursts, duration and looping) from its birth while it lives, born where the particle is at each tick (Unity's Birth sub-emitter, Niagara's particle-spawned emitters). It runs on the CPU path like the other sub-emitters and is deterministic per tick.

Every vfx element takes `move <x> <y> <z>` (metres per second) and `accelerate <x> <y> <z>`, which carry it from its offset from its start. An emitter spawns along the path, and a mesh, trail or light goes with it.

fixed.summary: Effects imported into one folder share their textures: each file is copied once into <out-dir>/textures/ (a different file of the same name under its name with its content's hash), not once per effect; importing again changes nothing.

An Effekseer ring whose edges differ in height (a tube or a cone, Effekseer's ring y) keeps its height. It was drawn with no width, and with a look's flat normals it cooked to no triangles and failed og.load.vfx with 'the model has no mesh'.

A model whose every triangle cooks away (every triangle has no area, or the art contract leaves none) is a cook error that names its primitives. It no longer cooks and then fails at load with 'the model has no mesh'.

An Effekseer node under an ancestor with many instances becomes a parent emitter that draws nothing, whose particles move as that ancestor does and each run the node's emission (`subEmitter life`). Before, the instances were folded into one emitter at one place. The finding stays only for deeper nesting and for meshes and trails.

An Effekseer element whose single-instance ancestor moves, with its location bound to always follow, moves with it (`move`, `accelerate`) from where the ancestor is when the element starts. A mesh node's own motion is carried the same way. Before, the element was placed where the ancestor started.
